settings.heading: Reviews
settings.lede: Star ratings and photo reviews belong on the piece they describe. This room explains where that proof appears. It does not invent scores.
settings.notice: Stars render when a reviews app writes the product rating metafield. Until then, cards and piece pages stay quiet rather than showing placeholder scores.

settings.heading: Where ratings appear
settings.text: On the catalogue card: title, photograph, price, colour swatches, and stars when a rating exists. On the piece page: the same stars, the review count, and any photo reviews the app attaches. Quick view on a card opens the piece without leaving the list.

settings.heading: Photo reviews
settings.text: Photographs from cooks stay with the piece, beside the studio images, so a patina shot is not mistaken for the product photograph. This page does not host unnamed testimonials.

settings.label: Browse the catalogue
settings.text: Open a piece to read its reviews.

settings.label: Ask Kansa
settings.text: Care questions have their own room.
